dependencies.optional_current_run: RHS AFRF/USAF/GREF/SAF and 3CB Factions installed on the dedicated fixture; optional addons are not bundled

features_in_this_package: Animated notification cards and repeat/queue handling
Host/full-admin money, influence and shared-fund tools
Campaign occupation-force selection, installed-mod filtering and persistence
English/Turkish presentation plus the earlier garrison, commander, gang and RHS features
count_note: Assertion executions include repeated scenarios across different mod configurations, not unique tests.

prior_evidence.note: Earlier feature/integration runs are historical evidence, not additional checks against this signed PBO.

limitations: This is a test release; stable gameplay acceptance is incomplete.
Two real clients, different language preferences, JIP, reconnects and locality transfers remain outstanding.
Dedicated admin login/logout and negative privilege tests with real connected players remain outstanding.
Full RHS/3CB GUI client startup did not complete in the earlier automation; the current full-mod checks ran on a dedicated server.
Native control-state checks do not replace screenshots or visual review at different resolutions/UI scales.
Prolonged battles and gameplay acceptance on every included terrain remain outstanding.
--no-bin preserves unchanged model assets without rerunning the Arma Tools model binarizer.
